'''Aly San San''' was a [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 waitress droid]] who worked as a spokesbot for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SWArchive-Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/startours_droids/index.html|text=Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids}}</ref> being featured extensively in public safety announcements and advertisements.<ref name="ATSS">{{Disney|domain=go.com|url=star-tours-adventures/aly|text=Aly}}</ref>

==History==
This droid's job was to make sure that Star Tours remained the premiere galactic tour agency. She had a friendly, sweet and enthusiastic personality.<ref name="ATSS" />

She was replaced by a [[Unidentified Star Tours safety spokesperson|Human counterpart]] sometime later.<ref name="OST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[George Lucas]] suggested the name Aly San San in reference to [[Allison Janney]], the actress who provides the voice for the character. The droid itself was also based on the [[WA-7 waitress droid/Legends|WA-7 service unit]] droid from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="DPB">{{DPB|url=2010/09/these-are-the-droids-youre-looking-for|text=These ARE the Droids You're Looking For!}}</ref>
